summary: Eleven dossiers and the brief were audited against the CURRENT FACTS, which they matched on roster, coach, record, DeRozan, Oct 22, Dec 25 and the Cup group. Three live spot-checks found real errors: Blake Street Tavern closed in 2023 and reopened under a new name, Great Divide closed its Denver taprooms in 2025, and Chauncey Billups faces a pending federal case, so he was removed from product ideas. Other fixes covered college conferences (Colorado State to the Pac-12), the navy hex mismatch, a wrong palette entry, the 1990s uniform colors, a James Beard award category, and unsupported claims (white-out, Mile High Magic, 2018 revival). The brief has timing problems: the CRUSH Walls reveal in September has passed, an Oct 22 launch lacks lead time, and the Marade route and Oct 22 home-opener framing are unconfirmed. About 20 named businesses, festival dates and partners remain queued as unverifiable.
